description: Put Lone Pair structures over a picture, such as a background an image model made with empty space for each molecule, so that no structure is drawn by the image model. Give the picture's size in pixels and, for each molecule, its structure and a box (x, y, width, height in the picture's pixels). Each molecule is drawn by Lone Pair, fitted to its box at one bond length for the whole figure, centred, and laid over the picture as the top layer on a white plate (plate: false for none). SVG (default): the figure the size of the picture, showing the picture by background_href; it can be checked again with verify_figure. PNG: a transparent overlay the size of the picture, to lay over it. The result gives each molecule's place, its bond length and its atoms' positions in the picture's pixels (for arrows and labels), and the check verify_figure makes. Refused, with the reason, instead of drawn wrongly: SMILES that cannot be read, aromatic rings that cannot alternate single and double bonds, and atoms with too many bonds (unless `as_written`).

background_href.description: The picture's file name or URL, written into the SVG so that it shows the picture (it is not fetched).

bond_length.description: Bond length in pixels for every molecule. Default: the largest that fits every box.

color.description: black (default); cpk to colour heteroatoms (N blue, O red, S yellow, halogens green); or one colour as #rrggbb for every line and label, such as #ffffff over a dark picture.

molecules.description: The molecules to place, each over the empty space left for it.

embed_id.description: Its id in the figure; needed when the same structure is placed twice.

highlight.description: Highlight parts of the structure with a coloured band under them, e.g. the atoms that react: [{ "atoms": [1, 2, 3], "color": "#ffe066" }]. Atoms are numbered from 1 in input order; bonds between listed atoms are highlighted too, and `bonds` adds others. SVG and PNG only.

bonds.description: Bonds as pairs of atom numbers.

name.description: True when structure is a compound name to look up at PubChem.

structure.description: SMILES, InChI or a molfile; a compound name with name: true.

x.description: Left of its box, in the picture's pixels.

outline_text.description: SVG: draw atom labels and text as outlines instead of text, so the figure looks the same in any program, with or without the fonts. Default false.

plate.description: A white rounded plate behind each molecule so it reads over the picture. Default true.

style.description: Journal style. acs = ACS Document 1996 (default), rsc = RSC, nature = Nature Reviews, slides = heavier lines for slides.

name: compose_figure
title: Put molecules over a picture
